MVP.name: Most Valuable Player
MVP.label: The eephus selection by in-league eWAR v2, batting plus pitching, summed before rounding. Not a forecast of the BBWAA vote.
MVP.floor_label: Floor: in-league PA of at least 252 or IP of at least 81 (1.55 PA and 0.5 IP per scheduled game, 162 games).
MVP.tie_label: Ties: unrounded score, then in-league WPA, then MLBAM id ascending.
MVP.two_way_label: Two-way: batting and pitching eWAR v2 both count; the row prints the split.

CY.name: Cy Young
CY.label: The eephus selection by in-league pitching eWAR v2. Not a forecast of the BBWAA vote.
CY.floor_label: Floor: in-league IP of at least 41 (0.25 IP per scheduled game, 162 games); relievers stay eligible.
CY.tie_label: Ties: unrounded score, then in-league IP, then SEM+ or REM+ raw, then MLBAM id ascending.

ROY.name: Rookie of the Year
ROY.label: The eephus selection by in-league eWAR v2, both sides, among players who pass the rookie test. Not a forecast of the BBWAA vote.
ROY.floor_label: Floor: PA of at least 100 or IP of at least 30 in the season.
ROY.tie_label: Ties: unrounded score, then in-league WPA, then MLBAM id ascending.
ROY.two_way_label: Two-way: batting and pitching eWAR v2 both count; the row prints the split.
ROY.eligibility_label: Rookie status: at-bats and innings from MLB's season lines; the 45-day roster test is the site's estimate from MLB's transaction log until the site measures service time.

MOY.name: Manager of the Year
MOY.label: The eephus selection by club-season wins above the club's own earned eWAR v2. Not a forecast of the BBWAA vote.
MOY.floor_label: No floor: every club in the league is ranked.
MOY.tie_label: Ties: unrounded score, then wins minus Pythagorean wins, then club code.
MOY.eligibility_label: Club-season. Manager names join when the manager ledger (M-MWAR-2) lands.

AL.tiebreak_sentence: Tied on the rule: Randy Arozarena, Ceddanne Rafaela at 5.7; ordered by in-league WPA.

superlatives.title: Former prospects: furthest above the grade at debut
superlatives.definition: Where a player's season eWAR v2 places him in the pool (percentile) minus where his eFV at debut placed him, one player at a time; ties share a rank.
superlatives.floor_label: Floor: PA of at least 300 or IP of at least 80 in the season. A PROSPX debuted row with an eFV at debut.
superlatives.frame_label: Debut seasons before 2020: the site holds out the prospect list vintages from 2020 and the debut cohorts from 2025 for registered checks of eFV, and each opens once its check is recorded.

superlatives.title: Furthest above the preseason projection
superlatives.definition: Season eWAR v2 minus the eWAR v2 projected for the season in the file frozen the day before Opening Day, with that file's P10 to P90 band as context.
superlatives.floor_label: Floor: PA of at least 300 or IP of at least 80 in the season. A row in the frozen file.
superlatives.frame_label: Lit only when every registered check on the 2026 label season is recorded.
superlatives.producer: the frozen Opening Day projection file; ewar.json
superlatives.blocked_on: No projection was saved before the 2026 season. From 2027 this card reads the projection frozen the day before Opening Day, once that season's registered checks are recorded.

superlatives.title: Highest DEM+
superlatives.definition: DEM+ on the season's defensive innings; the printed value is the board's.
superlatives.floor_label: Floor: qualified on the board, at least 400 innings.

superlatives.title: Contact quality ahead of results
superlatives.definition: Savant xwOBA minus wOBA in wOBA points, unshrunk: contact quality above the results it produced.
superlatives.frame_label: Season 2026; the Savant join starts in 2026.
superlatives.producer: hitter_leaderboards.json hitters[], the Savant xwOBA minus wOBA column, served as xwoba_minus_woba

superlatives.title: Highest REM+ in high-leverage relief
superlatives.definition: REM+ among relievers used in high-leverage innings; the printed value is the board's.
superlatives.floor_label: Floor: qualified on the board, at least 40 IP and a gmLI of at least 1.2.

superlatives.title: Most realized value from pitching changes
superlatives.definition: Realized win probability added by the club's pitching changes, one family only and never summed with another; realized value, not skill.
superlatives.floor_label: Floor: at least 100 pitching changes in the season.
superlatives.frame_label: Season 2026; the decision ledger covers 2018, 2019 and 2021 on.
